name: browser-integration
description: Browser automation via the Chrome DevTools Protocol. A shared agent browser runs behind a local auth broker: Chrome on a private pipe (no debug TCP port), the broker exposes a token-guarded loopback WebSocket with peer-process verification. Multiple chats/apps attach to the ONE browser and take turns (single-active handoff; the browser survives, no reclaim/kill). Anti-detection via rebrowser-patched puppeteer. Russian/English tool titles. Telemetry disabled. The agent profile's own extensions load and run.
